title: AeroEcho PerceptionRecord v1
description: One sensor observation POSTed to the Core at http://<core>:8000/ingest. Units: seconds, degrees, metres. bearing_deg is relative to the probe's mic array, which is always placed facing the taped +y arrow: 0 deg = straight ahead (+y), positive = to the RIGHT. The Core knows where the probe is and handles position and front/back ambiguity. Unknown extra keys are allowed and ignored.

sensor_id.description: laptop_earphone_mics = Member 2 audio pipeline; esp32_csi_node = Core's ghop-ghop Wi-Fi adapter.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds (Python time.time()) at the END of the analysed window, laptop clock.

detect_score.description: Audio: P(Voice)+P(Cough)+P(Breathing) from the classifier softmax. Wi-Fi: ghop-ghop confidence.

bearing_deg.description: Audio: GCC-PHAT bearing relative to the array, clamped to [-60, +60], null when the correlation peak is unreliable. Wi-Fi: always null.

listening_quality.description: Audio: clip((snr_db + 10) / 30, 0, 1). Wi-Fi: link quality from packet rate and state.

primary_class.description: Audio uses Voice|Cough|Breathing|Machinery (argmax of softmax). Wi-Fi uses Respiration|Presence|None.

class_probs.description: Optional, audio only: full softmax, keys exactly Voice, Cough, Breathing, Machinery.

snr_db.description: Optional, audio only: raw SNR used to compute listening_quality (debug / evidence card).

tdoa_us.description: Optional, audio only: raw GCC-PHAT delay in microseconds, t_left - t_right (positive = right mic heard it first).

range_m.description: Optional, Wi-Fi only: ghop-ghop calibrated proximity. Only send if calibrated at the probe's current stop; otherwise null.

range_sigma_m.description: Optional, Wi-Fi only: 1-sigma uncertainty of range_m.
